verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own public API reference (latest version), and that reference is also served as markdown for AI agents, so programmatic access is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at common paths. missing for 10: documented evidence of API/UI feature parity, per-product API coverage (monitors, dashboards, SLOs, incidents, etc.), a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
